title: LindbladRenormalizationInputs
description: Pinned input schema for Phase 5 Lindblad renormalization. All inputs must be committed before execution.

primes.description: Prime spectrum to sweep. Standard: [2,3,5,7,11,13]. Extended: up to 997.

gamma_heal.description: Healing rate coefficient. Currently = C_ZERO = ln(10) ≈ 2.3026.

c_zero_empirical.description: Empirical field strength constant. CF-PENDING: not yet derived from MKT.

slope_ub_naive.description: SlopeUB under naive normalization. Known to be > 1 (7.23 at p=2). Must be < 1 after renormalization.

renormalization_target.description: Target SlopeUB after renormalization. Must be < 1.0, ideally < 1 - delta_crit = 0.83.

wetterich_rg_steps.description: Number of RG flow integration steps (if coupling_model = wetterich_rg).
